account_and_path.candidate_priority: Earlier causal entry timestamp, then larger displacement z, larger overlap bps and lexical candidate id.
account_and_path.long_stop: Below the sell-side sweep extreme by one observed tick.
account_and_path.position_exit: Structural stop or frozen draw-on-liquidity target only; no elapsed-time exit.
account_and_path.setup_invalidation: Before entry, invalidate if the sweep extreme is broken again or the frozen target is reached.
account_and_path.short_stop: Above the buy-side sweep extreme by one observed tick.
account_and_path.target: Opposite-side prior external-liquidity extreme frozen at BPR formation.

fit_selection.selection: At most three passing candidates, ordered by 24bp mean, 12bp top-removal return, positive segment count, then candidate id.

information_contract.aggressive_flow: Buy quote notional minus sell quote notional divided by total quote notional, based only on completed trades.
information_contract.bar_availability: One-second OHLC and flow become available only after that UTC second is complete.
information_contract.entry: First actual trade in the second after a completed retest-confirmation bar.
information_contract.missing_seconds: No synthetic OHLC bar. A prior close may be used only for rolling return state when the last actual trade is no older than two seconds; FVG, sweep, retest, entry and exit all require actual trades.
information_contract.rolling_volatility: Prior 300 completed one-second returns, shifted one second, at least 180 finite and 40 nonzero observations.
information_contract.source_boundary: An unresolved position at a non-contiguous sample boundary is charged its full structural stop loss plus the registered cost; no favorable day-end market exit.

market.venue: Bybit USDT linear perpetual public trades

promotion_boundary.if_development_survives: Expand unchanged over additional pre-2024 dates, add exact Bybit funding and executable quote replay, then freeze before any official 2024 opening.
promotion_boundary.if_fit_survivor_but_development_fails: Retire the selected dependency and do not open 2024.
promotion_boundary.if_zero_fit_survivors: Retire the exact causal one-second sweep-displacement-FVG-BPR-retest dependency without adjacent threshold tuning.

purpose: Fatal pre-2024 test of a causal SMC/ICT Balanced Price Range entry translated from chart narrative into exact Bybit public-trade rules.

smc_ict_translation.balanced_price_range: The exact price overlap of two opposing causal FVGs formed within the frozen pairing interval.
smc_ict_translation.consequent_encroachment: The midpoint of the BPR overlap.
smc_ict_translation.displacement: Three completed one-second bars create a directionally aligned FVG and a prior-volatility-normalized move with aligned aggressive quote-notional flow.
smc_ict_translation.draw_on_liquidity: The opposite-side external-liquidity extreme already known when the BPR forms.
smc_ict_translation.entry_model: After the second displacement, enter only on the first causal retest and rejection of BPR consequent encroachment in the second-displacement direction.
smc_ict_translation.external_liquidity: Prior completed 120s or 300s extreme; no future pivot or equal-high confirmation.
smc_ict_translation.fair_value_gap: Bullish when bar t low exceeds bar t-2 high; bearish when bar t high is below bar t-2 low. The zone is known only at the end of bar t.
smc_ict_translation.liquidity_sweep: Price trades beyond the prior external-liquidity extreme, then the second displacement closes back through it.
